title: René Descartes's birth chart
metaDescription: René Descartes's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 10.9° Aries. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Four of the nine placements whose signs are settled stand in Aries — the Sun, Jupiter, Uranus and Pluto. The placements whose signs could change with an unknown hour are not counted. A cluster that size becomes the section the rest of the chart plays around.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's exact place is 10.9° Aries. That falls in the second decan, 10°–20°, sub-ruled by the Sun in the classical scheme — a fire sign read through a cardinal season.

blocks.title: The personal registers
blocks.text: The personal planets sit Venus at 6.3° Taurus, Mars at 22.2° Gemini. Venus in a earth sign reads as taste for the substantial and the lasting; Mars in a air sign reads as drive that argues its way forward.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Start where the chart is tightest — Jupiter conjunction Uranus, 0.8° of separation. The tradition stops reading a conjunction as two things. It is one appetite with two names, and it moves together or not at all. Behind it, Jupiter trine Neptune at 1.1°, and Uranus trine Neptune at 1.9° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. These angles were checked through every hour of that civil day and survive throughout, which is why an unrecorded hour does not disturb them.

blocks.title: The standing structure
blocks.text: The day-stable angles form no closed figure. Nothing funnels; each aspect is its own negotiation, which the tradition reads as a chart of separate treaties rather than one campaign.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Of the seven planets the classical scheme judges, three sit in a sign it has an opinion about. The Sun in Aries at 10.9° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best; the Moon in Taurus at 10.0° is in exaltation; Venus in Taurus at 6.3° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules. None of these labels is a verdict on a person; they describe how a function is situated, nothing more.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Of the 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: 5 in fire, 3 in earth, 1 in air by element, 4 cardinal, 3 fixed, 2 mutable by modality. Fire signs carry the scheme’s forward pressure: heat applied early, patience treated as a later skill. Mercury crossed from Aries into Taurus during that day, so its sign is left open. No settled placement falls in water — an absence the tradition treats as information, not as a defect. Saturn and Neptune were retrograde — the backward drift a body appears to make as the Earth overtakes it, read in the scheme as a function that reviews before it releases.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Taurus for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 11.8° between midnight and midnight. The sign survives the missing hour; the degree does not, and is given as a reference rather than a fact. At the noon reference it stands at 10.0°.
